chunks: Ali ibn al-Husayn narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Hassan al-Razi, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Kufi, from Ibrahim ibn Abi al-Bilad, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn al-A'lam al-Azdi, from his father, from his grandfather, who said: The Commander of the Faithful said:

Before the appearance of al-Qa'im, there will be red death, white death, and locusts in their season, and locusts out of their season, red like blood. As for the red death, it is by the sword; and as for the white death, it is the plague.

key_terms.الْقَائِمِ: The Awaited One, specifically referring to Imam al-Mahdi (as)
key_terms.مَوْتٌ أَبْيَضُ: White death, interpreted as death caused by plague or disease
key_terms.مَوْتٌ أَحْمَرُ: Red death, interpreted as death caused by war or the sword

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of red and white death before the appearance of al-Qa'im?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam Ali (as) in al-Nu'mani's *Kitab al-Ghayba* outlines specific eschatological signs preceding the reappearance of al-Qa'im, distinguishing between 'red death' (war) and 'white death' (plague) alongside anomalous locust swarms. Scholars interpret these as both literal calamities and symbolic indicators of the moral and physical decay characterizing the pre-appearance era, emphasizing the urgency of spiritual preparedness during the Great Occultation.
